notes.title: 1 year after release
notes.notes:
Hey Guys,

as it's quite a year passed since  Three kingdoms story:Conussia has been released on Steam, I decided to share some information.

Firstly, I would like to thank all of you for purchasing and playing the game. It's the first game I developed with help of several wonderful guys. Though, the game has several weak points, it's still got some kind of success and I really appreciate it, as it wouldn't be possible without your support, guys.

Secondly, selling this game brought some funds, which made development of the second game The Book of Bondmaids possible. The game is about to be released, it has much more arts, longer story and written originally in english by our lead scriptwriter Trude Perkins, so there won't be any problem with english language, like at the first game.

The work is not on hold, we continue development and the only thing we ask for is to stay with us.
We have no marketing department or even a single guy, who deals with it, so our possibility to extend the audience is very limited. 

If you like what we do, you can support development with following actions:

1. Create a review of the game on Steam. That takes 5 minutes, but bring a great impact.
2. Check out our website: KamtiGames. There you always can find information about development.
3.  Leave your impression on Steam group. Feedback from you is priceless!

Independent development  takes all time, energy and money. The most of these things are renewable. Money can be earned, new time is given every day, after sunrise. The only thing, which is difficult to get is energy, you cannot get it by wish. But since I started the games development, I understood one thing - energy and motivation can be granted by community. Every good word and actually a bad one is counted and makes sense.

Thanks for your support during this year!
